name: Medicare — ECM.1 line level versus total mismatch
description: Identify PX_ECM and check the event hierarchy, compare the COB Total line against the three Detail lines column by column, read the per-line discounts off the EOB claim form, enter them into the Disc boxes, Validate and Pay.

steps.name: Identify the ECM event and check the event hierarchy
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab. The application displays every edit the claim hit, and PX_ECM is the current event requiring review — the line-level-versus-total mismatch event, which occurs when the total amount matches the expected value but the corresponding values are missing or incorrect at the individual claim-line level. Read down the All Edits list in hierarchy order and check the Severity beside each code to determine whether any event must be resolved before PX_ECM. If one is, resolve it first in hierarchy order; if none is, carry on. Here every event is Informational, so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is clicked while this step is active. It is the tab the workspace opens on, so the click is a deliberate one.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the All Edits list shows PX_ECM marked (Active), and a Severity beside every code. Read them all before moving on.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the ECM event and check the event hierarchy

steps.name: Compare the Total line against the Detail lines
steps.description: Go to the Claim Data tab and open the COB sub-tab. Review the claim-level Total line against all three Detail line dollar amounts, and validate whether the COB and/or Medicare amounts on the Total line balance with the Detail line amounts for each column. Check each amount column separately: add its line-level values and compare the sum against that column's claim-level total. Check every column — even a small difference means the lines do not balance, and ECM can be triggered by a mismatch in just one column. Here the discount has a claim-level total but no line-level values, so its line amounts cannot add up to that total.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes on opening Claim Data > COB. The column-by-column comparison it asks for has no field to type into and no single field whose focus would evidence it; forcing focus onto a column would hand over the answer this step exists to make the trainee find. Step 4 is where the finding is graded — a trainee who skipped the comparison has nothing to type.
steps.hint: Claim Data > COB. Take one amount column at a time: add the three Detail line values and compare the sum against that column's Total.
steps.checklistItem: Compare the Total line against the Detail lines

steps.name: Review the EOB claim-form discount values
steps.description: One column has a claim-level total that its line amounts cannot add up to, so the next step is to check the claim form for the correct amounts. Scroll down on the COB sub-tab and expand "EOB (Claim form) details" to see them. In the live system you would read these values from the claim form itself; in this application they are shown in this accordion.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when open_eob_details is dispatched. A reveal button rather than a collapsible section, because expanding a section fires no completion trigger and this step has to be graded. Design D6.
steps.hint: Scroll to the bottom of the COB sub-tab and click "EOB (Claim form) details".
steps.checklistItem: Review the EOB claim-form discount values

steps.name: Update the Disc values on lines 1-3
steps.description: Use the claim-form values to update the three discount lines. In Claim Data > COB, edit line 1 to 85.30, line 2 to 51.95 and line 3 to 27.38 in the Disc text input boxes. Once the discount column balances to the claim-level total of 164.63, the ECM event will resolve.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when cob.lines.line3.disc is set to 27.38. Lines 1 and 2 are confirmed by the Validate guard on step 5, which tests all three — one step grades one field.
steps.hint: The claim form gives the discount per line. Enter all three into the Disc boxes; they must add up to the 164.63 total.
steps.checklistItem: Update the Disc values on lines 1-3

steps.name: Validate the corrected amounts
steps.description: Confirm the updated values have been entered correctly — line 1 at 85.30, line 2 at 51.95 and line 3 at 27.38 — then navigate to the claim summary and click the Validate button. Validate is refused while any of the three is wrong, and the balance check on the COB sub-tab says so.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when validate is dispatched AND all three Disc amounts satisfy the guard. The guard uses equalsAmount, not equalsIgnoreCase, so it is never stricter than step 4's grading.
steps.hint: Check all three Disc boxes against the claim form, then click Validate on the claim summary bar.

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: Navigate to the Decision section in the claim summary, select 'Pay' from the dropdown menu and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes on submitting the claim with the Pay decision.
